# Render

> Render builds websites that actually bring local businesses more customers.
> Fixed, published prices, live demo sites you can click right now, and on-site
> local SEO with every build. Founder-led by Tim Pactwa (Computer Science,
> Virginia Tech) and Luke Wilkins (Finance, Virginia Tech), serving Morris
> County, New Jersey.

Every price is published on the site. No sales call is required to see a number.
Last updated July 2026.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design): custom-built, mobile-first websites, live in 2 to 4 weeks.
- [Local SEO](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/local-seo): on-site local SEO standard with every build, plus Google Business Profile setup and optimization.
- [AI Consulting & Automation](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/ai-automation): after-hours replies, lead routing, review requests that send themselves.
- [Care Plan](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design): optional monthly maintenance covering hosting support, updates and fixes. Month to month, cancel anytime.

## Pricing (published, USD)

- [Starter](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design): $500 build plus optional $99/mo Care Plan. 1-3 page website. Regular price $1,500.
- [Standard](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design): $750 build plus optional $149/mo Care Plan. 4-6 pages with local SEO. Most chosen. Regular price $2,900.
- [Premium](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/services/web-design): $2,000 build plus optional $199/mo Care Plan. 7+ pages with booking or lead workflow. Regular price $4,900.
- [Custom](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/contact?tier=Custom): scoped per project with a fixed number before commitment. Multi-location, e-commerce, or AI automation.
- [Full price list](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/pricing.md): the same tiers in a machine-readable table.

Founding client pricing: the build prices above are discounted rates for Render's
first 5 clients. They rise to the regular prices listed once those slots are
filled. Care Plan prices are not discounted.

Guarantee: the first design direction is free. If it is not right, the client
walks away and no deposit is taken.

## Service area

Based in Morris County, NJ. Primary towns: Randolph, Denville, Morristown,
Parsippany, Madison. Nearby Morris County towns welcome.

- [Service areas](https://www.renderlocalwebsites.com/service-areas): the towns Render serves and what local search looks like in each.
